editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Saxo Bank is the most legitimate broker in this review series — scoring 8.2/10 from NAFT in 2026. Seven Tier-1 regulatory licences, an S&P investment-grade credit rating, 71,000+ instruments, and majority ownership by J. Safra Sarasin Group (€1.1B acquisition, March 2026) place it in a category above every other platform reviewed. The 59-63% retail loss rate is the lowest in the series — a direct reflection of the more sophisticated client base it attracts. But Saxo is not built for the typical retail forex trader with a $100 account looking for the cheapest pip. Classic tier pricing is average. The competitive rates require Platinum or VIP status. No MetaTrader. No social trading gimmicks. This is the broker for the serious multi-asset investor who has moved beyond forex scalping and wants institutional-grade market access from one account.
